**Observations:**

- **Layer-1 init footprint.** Weights for pixels the data never touches (image row 0 except cols 12–15, the corners, cols 0–3/24–27 in the top and bottom few rows, row 27 cols 0–3 and 24–27) sit at exactly the PyTorch default init scale, |w| ≤ 1/√784 ≈ 0.036 (e.g. inputs 0–11, 16–31, 52–57, 84–85, 111–112, 699, 727, 754–759, 780–783). That is what untouched weights look like with no weight decay; nothing in those always-blank regions has been trained.
- **Support of the trained weights.** Trained weights fill a rounded region: rows 1–27 and columns ~2–27, with column 27 used at rows 4–20, column 0 at rows 8–22, row 27 at cols 4–23, and row 0 only at cols 12–15 (small, ≤0.09, same sign pattern as row 1 below it). This is the Fashion‑MNIST footprint (tall garments touch top/bottom, wide items touch the side columns, boot shaft upper‑right, toe lower‑left), not MNIST's blank 4‑pixel border — so the strong weights in rows 1–3 and 25–27 are expected for this dataset.
- **Spatial smoothness.** Every large weight is embedded in a smooth gradient with its neighbors, e.g. unit 0's +0.4…0.61 ridge along cols 21–25, rows 11–19 (inputs 358/359/387/444/472/500); the diagonal "sleeve edge" from (4,20) to (11,25) where unit 2 is −0.3…−0.54 and unit 3 +0.3…0.44 (inputs 162, 192, 220, 248, 276, 304, 333); units 2/4/7/10/14 all −0.3…−0.55 across rows 2–3 cols 8–18 (inputs 64–78, 93–100); units 14/15 −0.25…−0.48 and unit 5 +0.3…0.47 across rows 25–27; narrow centre‑column (col 13–14) ridges in units 5, 6, 11 at rows 10–14 (the trouser‑gap feature). No isolated pixel or small patch has weights out of line with its surroundings; max |W1| ≈ 0.61.
- **Hidden units.** All 16 units carry structured, distinct receptive fields with similar ranges (roughly ±0.3–0.6); no dead, duplicated, or sign‑flipped copies; b1 in [−0.42, 0.36].
- **Output layer.** W2 entries are spread in ±1.1 with mixed signs in every row and column; no hidden unit is a one‑class "detector" row, no class column dominates; b2 in [−0.43, 0.37].

**Unusual:** No

**What:** nothing

**Confidence:** 20%
